findings.basis: ASUS obiwan vendor CarrierConfig overlay in the LineageOS device tree for 440-51 (one OEM source, medium confidence, 2022-09-06). It is an OEM's vendor carrier config for KDDI, so a real carrier setting, but only one device carries it and it was written for a vendor IMS stack.
findings.effect: Parsing: ImsPhoneCallTracker reads each 'FROM|MESSAGE|TO' entry (ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:2022-2061). FROM is an ImsReasonInfo code, not a raw SIP status. '*' as FROM matches by message only and needs a non-empty message (3263). An empty MESSAGE ('332||338') matches every message for that code, because the ArrayMap lookup calls key.equals(stored) and the lower-cased actual message only has to start with the stored text (1211-1250, 3243-3291; ArrayMap.java:140-176). Use: maybeRemapReasonCode feeds only getDisconnectCauseFromReasonInfo (3298-3485), the precise cause (3488-3491) and two metrics calls (3612-3618, 3779-3783). Every redial decision reads the raw, unmapped ImsReasonInfo: CS retry on CODE_LOCAL_CALL_CS_RETRY_REQUIRED (3625-3683), alternate emergency 1514 and the Wi-Fi E911 auto retry (3791-3816), RTT-off retry 3001 (3817-3820), the reasonInfo stored by conn.setImsReasonInfo (3635, 3789) that TelephonyConnection and maybeReselectDomain hand to domain selection (TelephonyConnection.java:2575-2611; TelephonyConnectionService.java:3103-3118), EmergencyCallDomainSelector's retry-code list and TEMP/PERM switch (EmergencyCallDomainSelector.java:561-577, 1829-1835) and NormalCallDomainSelector's CS redial (NormalCallDomainSelector.java:334-350), which covers WPS, TTY and RTT calls. The mapped code reaches emergency handling through four doors only: (1) the non-domain-selection path redials on another slot only for DisconnectCause EMERGENCY_TEMP_FAILURE or EMERGENCY_PERM_FAILURE (from codes 363/364) (TelephonyConnection.java:2615-2626); (2) maybeReselectDomainForEmergencyCall skips reselection when the DisconnectCause is LOCAL (from 501) or POWER_OFF (from 111/1500) (TelephonyConnectionService.java:3131-3146); (3) ImsPhoneConnection.onDisconnect lets INCOMING_REJECTED (from 143, 1017, 1404) replace the LOCAL that a user hang-up set (ImsPhoneConnection.java:555-566), which feeds door 2; (4) EmergencyCallDomainSelector.getDisconnectCause starts from the mapped precise cause (its TEMP/PERM switch reads the raw code, and the IMS map gives IMS_EMERGENCY_TEMP/PERM 1342/1343, not the 325/326 it tests) and ends selection on NO_VALID_SIM, which the map gives for code 1501 (445-470, 561-577, 1819-1845). Everything else the mapped code changes is shown or logged: Telecom code, label, description and tone (DisconnectCauseUtil.java:138-262), call-log type and missed-call notification (CallLogManager.java:160-176; ImsPhoneCallTracker.java:3736-3758), metrics, and Telecom's auto-unhold of a held non-emergency call after a new call fails in setup with code ERROR (CallsManagerCallSequencingAdapter.java:246-253); new non-emergency calls are aborted during an emergency call (CallsManager.java:2379-2392), so that cannot touch a held emergency call. Telecom's retry on a create failure ignores the code (CreateConnectionProcessor.java:643-653) and EmergencyStateTracker never reads the disconnect cause. On this build domain selection is off (config_domain_selection_service_component_name empty, no device overlay; DomainSelectionResolver.java:139-146), so the live emergency paths are the raw-code CS retry and door 1; doors 2-4 matter if 24.0 or a later overlay turns domain selection on. AOSP ImsStack: the extra message is the Reason header text (enrich flag true, carrier_config.xml:314; CallReasonInfo.h:325-354; Q.850 texts arrive as 'q.850;...'). A CANCEL already becomes 1014 for 'call completion elsewhere' or cause 200 and 1017 for 'another device sent all devices busy response' or cause 600/603 (CancelHandler.cpp:26-27, 62-86); a BYE saying 'call has been pulled by another device' already becomes 1016 (TerminationHandler.cpp). An emergency INVITE failure becomes CS retry 146 with an empty message by default, or 363/364 with an empty message, and a SIP code with Reason text only where the ImsStack's per-carrier emergency reject table says terminate (EmergencyStartErrorHandler.cpp:72-141). The ImsStack itself never reads this key (also on branch ocd). Entries of this value: '332||338': Empty message, so every 403: SERVER_ERROR -> BUSY (Telecom BUSY, busy tone, no auto-unhold of a held normal call). Both non-LOCAL, precise SIP_BUSY is not acted on, no TEMP/PERM involved: no door. On the AOSP ImsStack an emergency INVITE 403 normally becomes 146 before the mapping. '340||338': Every 406: SERVER_ERROR -> BUSY; same reading as 332||338; no door. '370||338': Every 421: ERROR_UNSPECIFIED -> BUSY; same reading as 332||338; no door.
findings.risk: Compared with the Google-lane ['510|Call completed elsewhere|1014']: adds three empty-message entries that turn every 403, 406 and 421 into SIP_BUSY (DisconnectCause BUSY, Telecom BUSY, busy tone and 'busy' label instead of a network-error label) and drops 510 'completed elsewhere' -> 1014 (incoming call log only). For an emergency call that ends with 403/406/421: both causes are non-LOCAL, so reselection with domain selection is unchanged; precise SIP_BUSY is not one of the causes the selector acts on; no TEMP/PERM is involved, so the non-domain-selection path ends the call either way. On the AOSP ImsStack an emergency INVITE 403/406/421 normally becomes CS retry 146 before the mapping, unless the ImsStack's KDDI emergency reject table says terminate. The one behavioural side effect is Telecom not auto-unholding a held normal call after a new normal call fails in setup with 403/406/421 (BUSY is not ERROR); new calls are refused during an emergency call, so the held call cannot be an emergency call. No entry of this value has 363, 364, 146, 1514 or 3001 as its source or 501, 111, 1500, 1501, 363 or 364 as its target, so doors 1, 2 and 4 stay shut; any door-3 case needs a busy/decline Reason text on an emergency INVITE that the AOSP ImsStack turns into 146 first. Emergency, TTY, RTT and WPS calls are placed, routed, retried and called back the same way; only the shown reason, tone and call-log class can differ. The user of a failed emergency call may hear a busy tone instead of an error tone; the call is placed, retried and routed the same way.

notes: Proceed. The entries reclassify 403/406/421 failures as busy, which changes the label, tone and the auto-unhold of a held normal call, but none of the four doors through which a mapped code reaches emergency handling. The basis is a single but real OEM vendor config for KDDI.
